name: explorer
about: Inspect a block and search the workspace. Starts from an open console and leaves it open.
gaps: ducktape-views@a2a73e1 explorer/src/presentation.rs:179 — every block row is named Inspect block: rows differ only by id or a child label
ducktape-views@a2a73e1 explorer — a search hit cannot be opened (it has only Copy reference)

steps.say: open the Explorer tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Explorer tab is selected and the explorer view shows a Search messages, pages, issues, files, runs… field, a Refresh button and block rows (buttons named Inspect block); no failure state (no failure title such as 'This network does not list this view', no Retry button) and it is not still loading

steps.say: press the first Inspect block row
steps.expect: a block opens: a label Block N, a Copy block hash button and Block hash, Commit and Operations rows

steps.say: search the workspace: type qa and Enter into the search field
steps.expect: search results show: an All filter button with result rows, or 'No matching results.' (Searching… is a state, not an error)
